text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on hybrid/office ops — short thread for travel, offsites, desk booking, and reimbursements. Ask one-line Qs.
Claire: For small team offsites (<=12 ppl) is the $500 stipend still applicable?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, $500/person for team offsites under 50. Use Concur, tag `OPS_OFFSITE`, attach attendee list.
Ben: If I extend a business trip for personal days, can I still expense the flight?
Nina (People Ops): Only the business portion. Split the expense, or mark the personal portion as non-reimbursable and note it in Concur.
Mateo: Desk hoteling — portal shows full next week. Any overflow plan?
Nina (People Ops): Join the waitlist. We reserve overflow desks in the Commons and will open booked meeting rooms as needed. For customer visits, note the meeting in the desk request and we'll prioritize.
Claire: Are coworking day passes for customer meetings reimbursable?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, up to $50/day, code `TRAVEL_MEET_COWORK`. Social coworking is not covered.
Ben: Visa fees for company-requested >30 day exchanges? Covered?
Nina (People Ops): Covered. Code `VISA_SUPPORT` and start a ticket early so ops can coordinate with immigration vendor.
Mateo: How long do reimbursements take after approval?
Nina (People Ops): Typically 7-10 business days after manager approval. DM me if it's longer.
ops-bot: calendar: Created event "All-Hands Ops: Followups (Travel & Desk)" and attached Nina's notes.
Claire: Any TL;DR of common Concur codes?
Nina (People Ops): TL;DR: `OPS_OFFSITE`, `TRAVEL_MEET_COWORK`, `HEALTH_TRAVEL`, `VISA_SUPPORT`, `EQUIPMENT_SHIP`, `LOCAL_PARKING`, `TRAVEL_CHILDCARE`. I'll post a one-pager + 3-min Loom by EOD.
Mateo: Thanks — very clear.
